verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents an official Java SDK that gives "convenient access to all features of the API" (Java 8+), including job waiting with a default timeout and convert/download/delete flows, so developers can build against an official SDK. Coverage is limited to a single language; the other languages are offered only as code samples, which are not SDKs. missing for 10: official SDKs in additional languages (e.g., Python/Node), in-depth SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes 404).
